patterns_found.name: Inverse Head and Shoulders
patterns_found.evidence: Three distinct swing lows visible: left shoulder near 1775, head near 1725, right shoulder near 1775. Neckline resistance around 1800-1825. Current price 1832.8 is testing/breaking above neckline.

patterns_found.evidence: Prior bearish market structure of lower highs and lower lows broken. Higher low established at approximately 1775 after the 1725 low. Price is breaking above prior swing high resistance near 1825.
